title: Normalized Conversation Record
description: Canonical record for a single ChatGPT conversation after parsing and normalization.

source_id.description: Original conversation UUID from the export.

title.description: Conversation title as set by the user or auto-generated.

create_time.description: Unix epoch float of conversation creation.

update_time.description: Unix epoch float of last message.

model.description: Model slug used in this conversation, e.g. 'gpt-4', 'gpt-4o'.

message_ids.description: Ordered list of msg_ids in this conversation.

has_system_message.description: True if a system-role message is present.

shard_file.description: Filename of the shard JSONL containing this conversation.

shard_line.description: 0-based line number within the shard file.
